title.zh: 无共同引用的关联问题丢失真实接续
title.en: Unanchored incidence questions lose real continuation distinctions

claim.zh: 任意两个有局部左右单位的接合结构中，所有片段在无引用关联语言中同测。该粗说明对这套问题精确且最小，却可把同一已消耗历史的不可自接合误成可自接合。
claim.en: All fragments in any two joining structures with local left/right units agree in the unanchored incidence language. The coarse account is exact and reduced for that language yet can turn the same spent history’s impossible self-join into a possible one.

hypotheses.zh: HasUnits 对一般退化定理；具体反例复用 budgetProcess 的 admitted histories、trace_has_units 和 spend_cannot_self_join。
hypotheses.en: HasUnits for the general collapse; the concrete case reuses budgetProcess admitted histories, trace_has_units and spend_cannot_self_join.

correspondence.zh: 反例在已有单次消耗过程中比较真实片段与其粗代码；遗漏的是固定输入关系，不是任意本体身份或自由切换的谓词。
correspondence.en: The example compares an actual fragment of the existing one-use process with its coarse code; the omission is fixed-input joining, not arbitrary ontological identity or a freely toggled predicate.

detail.zh: 单位置提升映射的问答保真接入退化说明。
detail.en: Question fidelity of one-position lifting maps feeds the collapse account.

input.zh: units_collapse_open 从单位给出到单片段结构的 OpenMap，再得到所有片段同测。
input.en: units_collapse_open constructs an OpenMap to the singleton structure from local units, then yields agreement of all fragments.

conditions.zh: 保留局部左右单位及同一关联语言；不需要经典有限分支恢复。
conditions.en: Retain local left/right units and the same incidence language; classical finite-branch recovery is not required.

detail.zh: 保留同一配置的共同引用修复具体丢失。
detail.en: Shared reference within a retained configuration repairs the concrete loss.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。

detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 否定的是无引用语言足以解释完整接合的候选推论；不是生成基础不可能。局部单位未被证明为普遍条件；退化定理不需有限性。
detail.en: Refutes the candidate inference that unanchored questions suffice for full joining, not the possibility of generative grounding. Local units are not proved universal; the collapse theorem needs no finiteness.

limitations.zh: 否定的是无引用语言足以解释完整接合的候选推论；不是生成基础不可能。局部单位不由本轮证明为普遍条件；退化定理不需有限性。
limitations.en: Refutes the candidate inference that unanchored questions suffice for full joining, not the possibility of generative grounding. Local units are not proved universal; the collapse theorem needs no finiteness.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上重述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。每一片段取每一角色处，所有片段在角色中相同（Joining.RoleTotal.alike），映到自结合片段之结合的映射为开，而片段仍可不能与自身结合（RoleTotal.open_not_pairLifting、RoleTotal.collapse）；局部单位给每一片段每一角色（roleTotal_of_hasUnits），所以两带单位结构的片段在角色中相同（units_alike_in_roles）。外围的 trace_has_units 与 open_map_does_not_force_pair_lifting 以空公理报告逐字重述（trace_has_units_by_core、open_map_does_not_force_pair_lifting_by_core）。外围的关联步、答案相同与跨度经带重叠通配分支的匹配定义（登记研究的步经 xs[i]?），其编译后的定义用到 propext，凡提及它们的陈述公理报告都不为空；所以此主张在核心的角色框架（Joining.roleFrame）或保留框架（Joining.retainedFrame）上重述，不是逐字实例；桥接表明外围的开映射与局部有限即核心的（openMap_iff_incidence、locallyFinite_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Where every fragment takes every role, all fragments are alike in their roles (Joining.RoleTotal.alike), the map onto the joining of one fragment with itself is open, and yet a fragment may be unable to join itself (RoleTotal.open_not_pairLifting, RoleTotal.collapse); local units give every fragment every role (roleTotal_of_hasUnits), so fragments of two structures with units are alike in their roles (units_alike_in_roles). The periphery's trace_has_units and open_map_does_not_force_pair_lifting are restated exactly with empty reports (trace_has_units_by_core, open_map_does_not_force_pair_lifting_by_core). The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
